description:
Import the raw CSV file '/home/ga/Documents/raw_macro.csv' into Gretl. This file contains US macroeconomic data (Real GDP and Inflation) starting from the first quarter of 1984. 

Steps:
1. Open the CSV file in Gretl (File > Open > User files).
2. In the Import Wizard, configure the data as 'Time Series'.
3. Set the frequency to 'Quarterly' (4 observations per year).
4. Set the starting observation to '1984:1' (1984 Quarter 1).
5. Save the dataset as a Gretl data file to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/us_macro_ts.gdt'.
6. Create a time-series plot of the 'gdp' variable and save it as an image to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/gdp_plot.png'.
